description: Read-only access to 24 databases for AI agents over MCP: Postgres, MySQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, MongoDB, Neo4j, Pinecone, and more. List schemas, describe tables, sample rows, and run guarded queries.

interface.longDescription: Read-only access to 24 databases for AI agents over MCP: Postgres, MySQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, MongoDB, Neo4j, Pinecone, and more. List schemas, describe tables, sample rows, and run guarded queries. This package adds the skills; connect the connectpak MCP server once with `codex mcp add connectpak --env CONNECTPAK_CONNECTION=<connection> -- uvx --from connectpak==0.1.1 connectpak` (add `--env CONNECTPAK_ENGINE=<engine>` if the engine isn't in the connection string). The server runs on your machine with uv. Writes are rejected by a parser guard and by the engine's own read-only mode; every query has a timeout and a row cap.
defaultPrompt: What tables are in my database, and how do they relate?
